description:
Nes's SAW
Ships with cosmetic Skins. Splendid!
Includes:
-a handful of lovingly crafted ships, a weapon, as well as few portraits
-shiny ships with custom paintjobs, obtainable as battle salvage
-exploration content to discover while traveling across the sector
-cross-mod content
-a main menu mission to get acquainted with some of the new additions

Download

Requires LazyLib
Requires MagicLib

Nes's SAW can be safely added to an existing save.
To install, simply download the .zip file from the link above, unzip it in your Starsector mods directory, and enable it in the launcher.

To update a mod, first remove the old folder, then move in the new, updated one.
Merging or replacing a folder without removing the old one is one of the most common causes of crashes!

New ships:

New paintjob examples:
Complete preview can be found below under spoiler!

Complete showcase of all ship sprites as of 1.28.SSS

Portraits:
Thematically fitting portraits for player and npc use, as well as humorous player-exclusive portraits

Player-exclusive portraits are only available during character creation and will not otherwise appear ingame.
Weapons:
Laevatein Assault Cannon
Laevatein Assault Cannon

Large Ballistic
- triple barreled, rotary configuration of the venerable Mjolnir
-fires the same devastating round, in a prolonged burst
-more flux efficient, if all shots land
-high upfront flux cost per salvo
-less overall dps
-barrels go speeen~

Hellbore alternative look

Essentially a visual update for the vanilla hellbore cannon.

Those who prefer vanilla looks may simply remove hellbore_ sprites located in graphics/weapons from the mod folder.

descriptionHtml:
Nes's SAW
Ships with cosmetic Skins. Splendid!
Includes:
-a handful of lovingly crafted ships, a weapon, as well as few portraits
-shiny ships with custom paintjobs, obtainable as battle salvage
-exploration content to discover while traveling across the sector
-cross-mod content
-a main menu mission to get acquainted with some of the new additions

Download

Requires LazyLib
Requires MagicLib

Nes's SAW can be safely added to an existing save.
To install, simply download the .zip file from the link above, unzip it in your Starsector mods directory, and enable it in the launcher.

To update a mod, first remove the old folder, then move in the new, updated one.
Merging or replacing a folder without removing the old one is one of the most common causes of crashes!

New ships:

New paintjob examples:
Complete preview can be found below under spoiler!


Complete showcase of all ship sprites as of 1.28.SSS
Portraits:
Thematically fitting portraits for player and npc use, as well as humorous player-exclusive portraits
Player-exclusive portraits are only available during character creation and will not otherwise appear ingame.
Weapons:
Laevatein Assault CannonLaevatein Assault Cannon

Large Ballistic
- triple barreled, rotary configuration of the venerable Mjolnir
-fires the same devastating round, in a prolonged burst
-more flux efficient, if all shots land
-high upfront flux cost per salvo
-less overall dps
-barrels go speeen~

Hellbore alternative look
Essentially a visual update for the vanilla hellbore cannon.

Those who prefer vanilla looks may simply remove hellbore_ sprites located in graphics/weapons from the mod folder.
